```sql
SELECT CAST(num_count AS DOUBLE) / den_count AS ruling_intensity
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_count
    FROM rulings
    WHERE date >= '2017-02-01' AND date < '2017-03-01'
) n,
(
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS den_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode IN (
        SELECT code FROM sets
        WHERE releaseDate >= '2017-02-01' AND releaseDate < '2017-03-01'
    )
) d
```
